summary: Tested the ritenuta proposal from the supplier anagrafica in RegistraPassivaDialog (POST /passive/{pid}/registrazione/anteprima -> ritenuta_proposta) on a TEST_T115 company with Contabilita on. Backend: new test_iteration115 passes 8/8. UI (PassiveDetail -> Registra) passes every requested scenario: (1) cassa privata TC01 after editing the supplier: fields 20 / 1000, box 'cassa 40,00 € (cassa privata, fuori dalla base ritenuta) · ritenuta 20% su 1000,00 € = 200,00 €', anteprima has 13.03.002 Avere 200 and Fornitori Avere 1068,80; confirming saved registrata, rit 200, base 1000, aliquota 20, netto 1068.8, protocollo 1. (2) INPS rivalsa: 20 / 1040, box shows rivalsa INPS, ritenuta 208, fornitore 1060,80. (3) XML DatiRitenuta 104 at 10%, supplier made soggetto later: the dialog overrides it with 20 / 1000 = 200. (4) Forfettario: fields empty, box '(forfettario) · nessuna ritenuta', no ritenuta row. The proposal is still returned when the body carries ritenuta values, including different ones (10%/500 -> anteprima 50, proposal 200). A manual ritenuta (ritenuta_auto False) or a non-soggetto supplier gets no proposal. All TEST data deleted (0 left).

minor.endpoint: PUT /api/percipienti-style supplier update (server.py ~3598, loop on da_registrare invoices)
minor.issue: This code recomputes the ritenuta with its own inline formula (imp/(1+cassa%)*base%). It ignores the regime (forfettario/occasionale), the N1 rimborsi and cassa_info, so it duplicates base_ritenuta() and can give a different result. Plain PUT /api/parties/{pid} does not touch the invoices at all. The two supplier-edit paths behave differently.

_applica always sets ritenuta_auto False when the body has ritenuta_aliquota, and the dialog always sends it once the proposal is applied. After an un-register, reopening the dialog gives no proposal and riallinea counts the invoice as 'manuale', even if the user accepted the proposal unchanged. Consider keeping ritenuta_auto True when the body equals the proposal.

issues: Amounts show without a thousands separator ('1000,00 €', '1068,80 €'). The brief expected '1.000,00 €'. fmtEUR formatting is cosmetic and app-wide.

action_items: Optional: unify the supplier-edit ritenuta recompute (server.py ~3598) with base_ritenuta()/ritenuta_da_anagrafica
Optional: keep ritenuta_auto True on registration when the submitted ritenuta equals ritenuta_proposta
critical_code_review_comments: _proposta_rit handles forfettario (returns aliquota 0) and the frontend clears the fields. With had_rit, ritBody then sends 0, which correctly removes an XML ritenuta.
The proposal is applied only once, when the dialog opens. Debounced anteprima calls don't overwrite user edits. Correct.
In _proposta_rit the cassa for display falls back to imp - imp/(1+aliq), which assumes the cassa is included in imponibile. That holds for this scenario.
